_comment: Copy to config.local.json (gitignored). Holds URLs, selectors and folders only. Credentials live in Windows Credential Manager: the ShipStation login under credentialTarget, the Worker ingest secret (as the password) under ingestCredentialTarget. This file must never contain a password, 2FA code, cookie, token or secret, and the job refuses to run if it does.
_browserChannelComment: null = Playwright's bundled Chromium. "msedge" or "chrome" drives the installed browser (with this collector's own profile) where the bundled build will not start.
_outputDirComment: Used only when delivery is "drive" (rollback). Leave null otherwise.

exportSteps._comment: RECORD THESE ON THE WINDOWS HOST with `npx playwright codegen https://ship.shipstation.com/`. They must open the saved custom shipment export template (Revision 5 field list, no customer columns), set the ship-date range, and download.

exportSteps.selector: REPLACE: saved custom export template 'SB GP weekly'

shipstation_shipping_cost_report._comment: Insights → Reports → Shipping Cost. Recorded on the Windows PC (2026-10-02). Ship-date range {{reportFromUS}}–{{reportToUS}} (the 8 weeks ending last Sunday), one store, CSV. The download step takes the file from the network (capture): Edge/Chrome 154 driven by Playwright closed when the browser itself downloaded it.

shipstation_mapping_export._comment: Dormant (mapping only, never expense, never satisfies shipping readiness). The job refuses this kind unless enabled is true (rollback diagnostics only). Uses the top-level exportSteps.
